data.monitor_only: Monitor only (do not send control commands)

data.controlled_entity: Entity to control (optional). Supports climate, switch, number, and some custom domains.

data_description.learning_model: Adaptive learns heat loss, heating gain and background warmth together. Existing EKF/RLS choices are retained. All models update on complete learning intervals.

data.price_comfort_weight: Price vs comfort (0 = target, 1 = lowest cost within band)
data.monitor_only: Monitor only (do not send control commands)

data.heating_detection_enabled: Enable heating detection from supply/flow temperature

advanced_control.name: Advanced: control and virtual outdoor temperature

data_description.continuous_control_window_hours: Only used by legacy binary planning modes; the normal number-output planner chooses request strength directly.
data_description.virtual_outdoor_smoothing_enabled: Gradually changes the command sent to the heat pump. The command-aware planner includes this delay in its prediction.
data_description.virtual_outdoor_smoothing_alpha: Fraction of the remaining change applied per normal control interval, regardless of sensor update frequency. 0.5 moves halfway; 1 disables output smoothing. Used only when smoothing is enabled.

data_description.learning_model: Adaptive learns heat loss, heating gain and background warmth together. Existing EKF/RLS choices are retained. All models update on complete learning intervals.
data_description.learning_interval_minutes: Collect observations each minute; update the house model only after this interval. Does not change the control interval.
data_description.learning_fit_window_hours: Adaptive model only. Requires at least 24 hours of usable observations and changing outdoor temperatures.
data_description.pump_response_enabled: For number entities with measured heating and 15-minute control. Used in planning only after later observations confirm better predictions.

data.summer_heat_window_max_heat_demand_ratio: Summer heat max recent heat demand ratio

data_description.ufh_enabled: Optional and off by default. Uses measured supply temperature only, even when Pilot HVAC is off. Monitor-only suppresses switch commands. Disable any existing automation controlling these switches before enabling.
data_description.ufh_supply_entity: Unavailable or stale temperature holds pump states and reports a diagnostic fault.
data_description.ufh_switches: Select individual pump switches for independent runtime and idle tracking. Disabling this feature leaves their current states unchanged.

data.ufh_exercise_idle_hours: Exercise only after this idle period

data_description.ufh_exercise_enabled: Independent of Summer Heating and electricity prices. Exercises only idle pumps. If useful warmth arrives, temperature control takes over. Requires UFH pump control to be enabled.

data_description.price_comfort_weight: Among plans that best respect the temperature band, higher values favor cheaper heating and coasting; lower values keep closer to target. This is not a percentage of savings.
data_description.comfort_temperature_tolerance: Used on both sides of target. For target 20.5 and tolerance 1.2, the predicted allowed range is 19.3 to 21.7. Preheating above target is allowed, not required. Forecasts cannot guarantee actual temperature.

error.ufh_invalid_settings: Check UFH durations, exercise time, and pump switch selections.
error.ufh_invalid_thresholds: The UFH stop temperature must be lower than its start temperature.
error.ufh_missing_entities: Select a supply temperature sensor and at least one UFH pump switch.
error.ufh_switch_conflict: A UFH switch is already used by another Pilot controller or as this entry’s heat-pump output.
